verdict.rationale: Manufact is a cloud platform with a REST API (API keys) and an MCP server, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask. However, the evidence shows no versioned API scheme and no documented deprecation policy. A changelog exists and a community comment mentions a v2 of the mcp-use library, but neither establishes versioned endpoints or deprecation terms, and probes found no OpenAPI spec.
